items.html: Also the part of the externality of the vessels is divided into three other parts, which are the aspects of Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin, as is written with God's help. And the truth is that it would have been fitting for the externality to be only two parts, corresponding to the two Ohr Makifim. But elsewhere he wrote explicitly that there are three aspects of Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin in the externality alone, just as there are in the internality.
